programme.title: رشيد شو - Rachid show
programme.desc: ‫‫يتحدث رشيد العلالي مع المشاهير عن حياتهم المهنية والخاصة، ويتحدثون عن الشائعات التي سمعوها عن أنفسهم وإنجازاتهم وفعالياتهم القادمة.‬‬ Rachid Al Alali talks to celebrities to talk about their professional and private lives. They will talk about the rumours they have heard about themselves, their achievements and upcoming events.

programme.title: عائلتي - Aelati
programme.desc: ‫‫تبذل لولا، المرأة القوية والزوجة والأم لأربعة أطفال، قصارى جهدها للحفاظ على تضافر عائلتها، بينما تواجه العديد من الصعوبات الاجتماعية والمالية.‬‬ Lola, a strong woman, a wife and a mother of four, does her utmost to keep her family united as they face several social and financial hardships.

programme.title: الأمانة - Al Amanah
programme.desc: ‫‫مراد، ضابط متفان، يجد نفسه في موقف صعب بعد أن قتل رجلا بغير قصد. يشعر لاحقا أنه ملزم برعاية زوجة الرجل وابنه.‬‬ Morad, a dedicated officer, finds himself in a difficult situation after killing a man by mistake. Later, he feels that he is obligated to take care of the man's wife and son.

programme.title: جام شو - Jam Show
programme.desc: ‫‫يعتلي مغنو راب واعدون من كافة أنحاء المغرب خشبة المسرح ويعرضون مواهبهم لإبهار الحكام والتأهل للمراحل التالية والفوز باللقب.‬‬ Budding rappers from all across Morocco take the stage and showcase their talent to impress the judges, qualify for the next stages and win the title.

programme.title: من قلب الجهة - Men Qalb Al Jehah
programme.desc: ‫‫تخوض المضيفة في حوارات مع شخصيات وخبراء للحديث عن آخر وأكبر المشاريع، والتي تهدف إلى تطوير مختلف مناطق المغرب.‬‬ The host interviews personalities and experts to talk about the latest and biggest projects that aim to develop various parts of Morocco.

programme.title: توحشناك - Twahashnak
programme.desc: ‫‫التركيز على مجموعة متنوعة من الفنانين المغاربة، المعروفين في عالم الفن والثقافة، لتقديم أنفسهم ومناقشة إنجازاتهم.‬‬ A focus on various Moroccan artists, who are credited within the art and culture world, to introduce themselves and to discuss their achievements.

programme.title: هديك حياتي - Hadeek Hayati
programme.desc: ‫‬ Hadeek Hayati

programme.title: مواهب في تجويد القرآن - Mawaheb Fi Tajweed Al Quran Al Kareem
programme.desc: ‫‫يتنافس فتيان وفتيات تتراوح أعمارهم بين العاشرة والثامنة عشر عاما مع بعضهم البعض ويرددون آيات من القرآن الكريم.‬‬ Girls and boys between ten and eighteen years old compete against each other and recite verses from the Holy Quran.

programme.title: شهيوات بلادي - Chhiwat Bladi
programme.desc: ‫‫تسافر المضيفة إلى العديد من المناطق في المغرب من أجل إعداد وصفات شهية، كما تسلط الضوء على الأطباق الأكثر شعبية في كل منطقة.‬‬ The host travels to various places in Morocco to prepare delicious recipes and highlight the region's most popular dishes.

programme.title: شدى الألحان - Shatha Al Alhan
programme.desc: ‫‫يدعو المضيف عددا من الفنانين الصوتيين للمشاركة في فقرات متنوعة يستعرضون فيها مواهبهم ويناقشون مواضيع مثيرة للاهتمام تتعلق بحياتهم ومسيراتهم.‬‬ The host invites a number of vocalists to engage in an array of segments in which they showcase their talents and discuss interesting topics related to their lives and careers.

programme.title: جيب داركم - Jeeb Darkom
programme.desc: ‫‫يقوم محسن بتوظيف بعض الأشخاص ليمثلوا دور عائلته لإثارة إعجاب المرأة التي يحبها ووالديها المرموقين، إذ ليس لديه عائلته الخاصة.‬‬ Having no family of his own, Mohsen hires some people to act as his family in order to impress the woman he loves and her prestigious parents.

programme.title: سر المرجان - Sir Al Morjan
programme.desc: ‫‫تعود حسناء التي تعمل مدرسة إلى قريتها لتجد أن رجلا مستبدا يتحكم بسكان القرية وينهب حاجياتهم، كما يقوم ببيع المواد المخدرة.‬‬ Teacher Hasna comes back to her village to find that a domineering man controls the villagers, loots the goods and sells drugs.

programme.title: وجع القلب - Waja' Al Qalb
programme.desc: ‫‫تتواصل زوجة معنفة بمحامية وتعطيها خطاب وصية ليتم فتحه بعد وفاتها، إلا أن الخطاب يتبين بأنه بالغ الأهمية ما يتسبب بخلافات بين أفراد عائلتها.‬‬ An abused wife contacts a lawyer and gives her a testament letter to be opened after she dies. However, the letter turns out to be extremely important, causing conflicts amongst her family.

programme.desc: ‫‫بعد خروجه من السجن، يعود غواص للبحث عن الكنز المفقود والانتقام من الاشخاص الذين دمروا حياته وخانوه، مما يقلب الأمور رأسا على عقب ويقود للعديد من المواقف غير المتوقعة.‬‬ After his release from prison, Ghawwas returns to search for lost treasure and seek revenge on the people who ruined his life and betrayed him, turning things upside down and leading to many unexpected situations.

programme.title: أفترنون نيوز - Afternoon news
programme.desc: ‫‫يقدم المضيف آخر الأخبار والتطورات السياسية والاقتصادية والاجتماعية والرياضية في البلاد وجميع أنحاء العالم.‬‬ The host presents the latest political, economic, social and sports top stories on the national and international front.

programme.title: آفترنون شو - رمضان أحلى - Afternoon Show - Ramadan Ahla
programme.desc: ‫‫يستعرض فريق التقديم مجموعة متنوعة من الفقرات يحاور من خلالها خبراء في مجالات الصحة والاقتصاد والتكنولوجيا، وغيرها من المواضيع التي تهم الناس.‬‬ The hosts present a variety of segments through which they interview experts in health, economy, technology and array of other topics that interest people.

programme.title: الأنبياء - Al Anbeya'
programme.desc: ‫‫مجموعة شاملة ومتنوعة من القصص الدينية التي تدور حول الأنبياء ورسالتهم ورحلتهم والمصاعب التي واجهوها خلال فترة نبوتهم كما وردت في القرآن الكريم.‬‬ A comprehensive compilation of religious stories that revolve around the prophets, their message, journey and the hardships they faced during their prophecy as mentioned in the Holy Quran.

programme.title: الوجه الآخر - Al Wajeh Alakhar
programme.desc: ‫‫يفقد ضابط شرطة شاب والده بسبب وقوع سلسلة من الأحداث الثورية. في وقت لاحق، تتصاعد التوترات عندما يقرر الشاب الانتقام لوفاة والده.‬‬ A young police officer loses his father because of a revolutionary. Tensions ensue when he decides to take revenge for his father's death.

programme.title: اليتيم - Al Yateem
programme.desc: ‫‫بعد مقتل والد عرسان في نزاع عائلي على الميراث، يواجه العديد من القضايا والتحديات الاجتماعية في حياته اليومية، بينما يحاول التغلب على العقبات التي تضعها الحياة في طريقه.‬‬ After A'rsaan's father is killed in a family feud over inheritance, he faces various social issues and challenges in his daily life, as he tries to overcome the obstacles that life throws his way.

programme.title: إيفننغ نيوز - Evening news
programme.desc: ‫‫يعرض فريق التقديم عددا من القصص والأخبار المهمة وآخر الأحداث والمستجدات الهامة على الصعيد الوطني والدولي.‬‬ The host presents numerous top stories, latest happenings and significant updates from the national and international front.

programme.title: مولانا - Mawlana
programme.desc: ‫‫يواجه شيخ محترم وقوي، يحظى بإعجاب أتباعه، سلسلة من الصراعات التي تتحدى هويته وتكشف صلته بالسلطة والفساد، مما يدفعه إلى مواجهة معضلات أخلاقية صعبة.‬‬ A respected and powerful sheikh, admired by his followers, experiences a series of conflicts that challenge his identity and expose his connections to power and corruption, leading him to face difficult moral dilemmas.

programme.title: بخمس أرواح - Be Khams Arwaah
programme.desc: ‫‫‫يكتشف شمس أنه ابن وريث رجل ذي نفوذ كبير، ولكن لكي يتمكن من الحصول على ثروة والده، يجب عليه أن يفي بالشرط الوحيد الذي قام والده بوضعه.‬‬‬ Shams finds out that he is the heir of a very powerful man. However, in order for him to get access to his father's fortune, he must fulfil the only condition his father has made.

programme.title: بافيترام - Barroz
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح324 : ‫تستعد فيدا، ابنة القاضي المحترم، للزواج من صديقها طفولتها المقرب المحامي دارشان، إلا أن مصيرها يتغير بشكل غير متوقع، لتصبح زوجة لزعيم العصابة فيكرام.‬‬ Barroz, a loyal servant, is compelled by magic to guard Cristavao da Gama's treasure for four centuries, waiting for a true heir to claim it.

programme.title: بافيترام - Pavithram
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح324 : ‫تستعد فيدا، ابنة القاضي المحترم، للزواج من صديقها طفولتها المقرب المحامي دارشان، إلا أن مصيرها يتغير بشكل غير متوقع، لتصبح زوجة لزعيم العصابة فيكرام.‬‬ S1 , E324 : Veda, the daughter of a reputed judge, is set to marry her childhood friend and lawyer, Darshan. However, life takes an unexpected turn and she ends up marrying Vikram, a thug.

programme.title: مازها ثوروم مونبي - Mazha Thorum Munpe
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح223 : ‫بعد أن تترك في طفولتها، تبحث ألينا عن الحب الذي تتوق إليه. فهل ستقودها رحلتها إلى والديها المفقودين وإلى السعادة التي تستحقها؟‬‬ S1 , E223 : Abandoned as a child, Aleena embarks on a relentless search for the parents who left her.Her journey is filled with pain, but she must find the truth and the only happiness that can heal her.

programme.title: شيمبانير بوفو - Chempaneer Poovu
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح705 : ‫تحاول الشابة من الطبقة الوسطى ريفاتي إعالة أسرتها، لكن حياتها تتغير عندما تلتقي بالشاب المتغطرس ساشي.‬‬ S1 , E705 : Revathy is a young middle class woman trying to support her family. However, her life changes when she crosses paths with Sachi, an arrogant young man.

programme.title: باتهرماتو - Patharamattu
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح907 : ‫تسعى أم شجاعة وقوية جاهدة لتزويج بناتها الثلاث، إذ تبحث عن شريك مناسب لكل واحدة ليتحمل المسؤولية بجد.‬‬ S1 , E907 : With the obligation of marrying off her three daughters, a brave mother does her best to find a responsible partner for them.

programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح284 : ‫تسعى معلمة عظيمة وأم مخلصة في نفس الوقت جاهدة للتوفيق بين دوريها المتطلبين بينما تتوق إلى الحب الذي تستحقه بجدارة.‬‬ S1 , E284 : While juggling her roles of being a great teacher and a devoted mother, a woman remains desperate for the affection she has always yearned for but never received.

programme.title: Ee Puzhayum Kadannu
جانامايثري - Janamaithri
programme.desc: ‫‫يبدأ ضباط مركز شرطة باراميدو حملة مبتكرة للوصول إلى سكان المنطقة، إلا أن الأمور لا تسير كما هو مخطط لها وتقع الكثير من المشاكل.‬‬ The officers at Paramedu police station start an innovative campaign to reach out to the residents of the area. However, things do not go as planned and they land in all sorts of trouble.

Advocate Anjali

programme.title: أما ماناسو - Amma Manassu
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح654 : ‫تتمنى الأم العزباء شاندريكا أن تعيش حياة سعيدة مع ابنتها، ولكن لا يزال ماضي شاندريكا المضطرب يطاردها. مع ذلك، تتغير حياتها عندما تلتقي بلاكشمي.‬‬ S1 , E654 : As a single who wishes for a happy life with her daughter, Chandrika's turbulent past continues to haunt her. However, her life changes when she meets Lakshmi.

programme.desc: ‫‫تستمر بريا في مراقبة جيرانها من نافذة منزلها، وسرعان ما تنقلب حياتها بعد عودة جارها القديم، إذ يتغلب عليها فضولها، وتبدأ المطاردة بينهما.‬‬ Priya and her friend become suspicious of Manuel who returns to their neighbourhood. programme.desc: ‫‫تشاندران شخص غير مسؤول وسيء الأخلاق يترك فتاة تعاني وحدها بعد أن يعلم أنها حامل، ويتزوج من فتاة ثرية ولا ينجب أطفالا لسنوات عدة.‬‬ Two friends with contrasting personalities, navigate life's challenges differently. While one chooses a path of integrity, the other makes a selfish decision to abandon his pregnant girlfriend.

programme.title: Theertham
programme.desc: ‫‬ Theertham

programme.title: راتنيرفيدام - Rathinirvedam
programme.desc: ‫‫يقع بابو في حب راثي التي تكبره سنا، وحين يقيمان علاقة ذات يوم في الكنيسة تتعرض راثي للدغة أفعى، ما يجعل بابو يقف حائرا غير قادر على فعل شيء أو أخذها إلى أي مكان لأن علاقتهما سرية.‬‬ Pappu falls in love with Rathi, who is older than him. However, things take a turn for the worse when a snake bites Rathi and he is unable to ask for help due to their secret relationship.

programme.title: ديفي ماتاميام - Devi Mahathmyam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح760 : ‫مختارات من القصص التي تتناول الأساطير والخرافات المتعلقة بالإلهة دورجا، إلى جانب حكايات أشكالها ومظاهرها المختلفة.‬‬ S1 , E760 : An anthology of stories which deal with the legends and myths related to Goddess Durga, along with the tales of her various forms and manifestations.

programme.title: ماليكبورام - Malikappuram
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح14 : ‫عندما يقوم أقارب وأهالي مجتمع الطفلة أونيمول بطردها، يتخذ اللورد أيابان شكل طالب مدرسة لمساعدتها في التغلب على العقبات.‬‬ S1 , E14 : When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.

programme.title: ساندهياكو فيرنينجا بوفيو - Sandhyakku Virinja Poovu
programme.desc: ‫‫يعيش أخصائي الأمراض النسائية الدكتور بلاديفي مع شقيقه ثيلاكان. يسافر بلاديفي إلى الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية لمتابعة دراساته العليا، لكن حياته تنقلب رأسا على عقب عندما يتورط في العديد من المشاكل.‬‬ Dr Baladevi, a gynaecologist, lands in legal trouble when a woman dies during an abortion. She seeks help from advocate Jayamohan and learns some shocking facts about the deceased in the process.

programme.title: تشاميام - Chamayam
programme.desc: ‫‬ Rival fishermen Esthappan and Anto set aside differences when their shared passion for theatre opens doors to experiences beyond their everyday lives.

programme.title: فوتوغرافر - Photographer
programme.desc: ‫‫يقوم مصور الحياة البرية ديجو بإنقاذ الفتى القبلي تامي من يد ضابط شرطة سيء السمعة. يضع ديجو نفسه في ورطة عندما يقرر طرح القضية على عامة الشعب.‬‬ When wildlife photographer Dijo saves a young native boy, Thammi, from the clutches of a corrupt police officer, he unwittingly sparks a perilous quest for justice, putting his own life at risk.

programme.title: ماليكبورام - Malikappuram
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح15 : ‫عندما يقوم أقارب وأهالي مجتمع الطفلة أونيمول بطردها، يتخذ اللورد أيابان شكل طالب مدرسة لمساعدتها في التغلب على العقبات.‬‬ S1 , E15 : When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.

programme.title: إيتو جانما كالبانيل - Eatho Janma Kalpanayil
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح185 : ‫تلتقي الفتاة المرحة سروثي والتي تنتمي من عائلة متواضعة صدفة برجل الأعمال الثري المتغطرس أشوين، وسرعان ما ينشأ الحب بينهما.‬‬ S1 , E185 : Love blooms between Sruthy, a cheerful girl from a humble background and Ashwin, an arrogant wealthy businessman when they accidentally come across each other.

programme.title: تشاندريكايل أليونو تشاندراكانتام - Chandrikayil Aliyunnu Chandrakantham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح187 : ‫يتزوج ضابط الشرطة غوتام من الطبيبة الطموحة ألاكاناندا رغما عنه، لكن عندما تعود حبيبته الأولى إلى حياته، يجبر على الاختيار بين ماضيه ومستقبله.‬‬ S1 , E187 : Gautham, an IPS officer, is forced to marry Alakananda, an aspiring doctor. However, when his first love reenters his life, he is forced to choose between his past and his future.

programme.title: توفالسبارشام - Thoovalsparsham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح185 : ‫تتفرق شقيقتان في طفولتهما إثر جريمة قتل تقع في العائلة. بينما تكبر إحداهما لتصبح ضابطة شرطة، تسلك الأخرى طريق الجرائم الصغيرة لكسب عيشها.‬‬ S1 , E185 : Two sisters are separated during their childhood due to a murder in the family. While one becomes a police officer, the other turns to petty crime for a living.

programme.title: باداتا بينكيلي - Paadatha Painkili
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح186 : ‫تواجه امرأة شابة عذابا وقمعا مستمرا من عائلتها المتشددة، لكنها تظل صامدة في بحثها عن الحب والسعادة وتصمم على ذلك.‬‬ S1 , E186 : A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.

programme.title: ديفي ماتاميام - Devi Mahathmyam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح761 : ‫مختارات من القصص التي تتناول الأساطير والخرافات المتعلقة بالإلهة دورجا، إلى جانب حكايات أشكالها ومظاهرها المختلفة.‬‬ S1 , E761 : An anthology of stories which deal with the legends and myths related to Goddess Durga, along with the tales of her various forms and manifestations.

programme.title: سانثوانام - Santhwanam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح107 : ‫تعيش سريديفي حياة هانئة وسعيدة مع زوجها بالاكريشنان وأشقائه، لكن تواجه العائلة العديد من المصاعب التي تحد من علاقتها الوثيقة.‬‬ S1 , E107 : Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.

programme.title: موناراغم - Mounaragam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح1631 : ‫تعاني كالياني من ضعف في النطق وجميع أفراد عائلتها يكرهونها باستثناء والدتها. وبينما تتوق إلى حنان والدها، يدخل كيران حياتها.‬‬ S1 , E1631 : Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.

programme.title: غيثا غوفيندام - Geetha Govindam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح88 : ‫يواجه رجل أعمال في منتصف العمر أعزب ماضيه الغامض، مما يؤثر على علاقته الرومانسية الاستثنائية بشابة تصغره في السن.‬‬ S1 , E88 : When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.

programme.title: نمال - Nammal
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح136 : ‫تابع قصة ستة شباب وهم يتنقلون بين السعادة وقلوب منفطرة وجميع التحديات بمختلف المستويات التي تلقيها الحياة في طريقهم.‬‬ S1 , E136 : Follow the story of six youngsters as they navigate through happiness, heartbreaks and all the challenges that life throws at them.

programme.title: سانثوانام - Santhwanam
programme.desc: ‫‫ترتفع معنويات الزوجين المسنين عندما يزورهما حفيدهما، مما يسهم في إصلاح الخلاف الناجم عن زواج ابنهما الوحيد غير المرغوب فيه وانتقاله إلى الولايات المتحدة.‬‬ Elderly couple's spirits lift as their grandchild visits, mending the rift caused by their only son's unwelcome marriage and move to the States.

programme.title: أزاكيا تاميل ماكان - Azhakiya Tamil makan
programme.desc: ‫‫يعتبر غورو طالب ماجستير إدارة أعمال حاصلا على شهادة في اللغة الإنجليزية كلغة ثانية. يهرب إلى مومباي بعد أن يقوم بطعن حبيبته، ويتفاقم وضعه عندما يكتشف شبيها له في المدينة.‬‬ Guru, an MBA student with ESP, flees to Mumbai after foreseeing himself stabbing his girlfriend. His situation worsens when he discovers a criminal lookalike in the city.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing’s Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance—featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon—and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as “Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate,” “Mudfish Eating Dumplings,” and “Three Dragons.” Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China’s most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing’s Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance—featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon—and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as “Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate,” “Mudfish Eating Dumplings,” and “Three Dragons.” Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China’s most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.
A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever.
And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.
A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever.
And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People

Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.
A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever.
And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.
A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever.
And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or “Five Terraces.” The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
مهووسان متشابهان
حان وقت المعرض السنوي للخيال العلمي / كتب الرسوم المتحركة في المدينة والبلدة بأكملها موجودة هناك. "فارس" و"فادي" متحمسون بشكل خاص لأن بطلهما، عبقري المؤثرات الخاصة، "كليف أديسون"، سيكون هناك على الهواء مباشرة. ومع ذلك، تكمن خطتهم في توضيح "للسيد أديسون" انحراف تصاميم مؤثراتهم الخاصة عند انسياقهما في المبارزة بين محبي الخيال ومحبي الخيال العلمي. ينبغي على الأخوين توحيد الطرفين حتى يتمكن الجميع من الاستمتاع. وفي هذه الأثناء، تحاول "سندس" إخفاء سر خاص بها وعدم ضبطها - فهي من محبي خزانة "دكاي مومو". في جزء مختلف من المعرض، يفكر "أبو الأشرار" في خطة خاصة به. لقد أخذ مديرًا تنفيذيًا للشبكة كرهينة حتى يتمكن من عرض برنامجه التلفزيوني "دوف آند بوز" Nerds of a Feather (Part 1 and 2)
It’s time for the annual Science Fiction/Comic Book Convention in Danville and the whole town is there. Phineas and Ferb are especially excited since a hero of theirs, special effect genius, Clive Addison, will be there live. However, their plan to show Mr. Addison their special effects designs gets sidetracked when they are swept up into the duel between the fantasy fans and the sci-fi fans. The boys must unite the two sides so that everyone can just get back to having fun. Meanwhile, Candace is trying to hide a secret of her own and not get busted – she is a closet “Ducky MoMo” fan. In a different part of the convention, Doofenshmirtz has a plan of his own. He has taken a network executive hostage so he can pitch his “Doof ‘N’ Puss” TV show.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
بطن الوحش / مزرعة القمر
من أجل احتفال أيام "الميناء"، يحتفل" فارس" و"فادي" باختراع نسخة ميكانيكية لقرش "ميناء دانفيل" المراوغ. وحينما ترى "سندس" ما يفعله الأخوان، تحاول الحصول على المساعدة للإمساك بالقرش الغامض. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يخترع جهاز للمياة المالحة من أجل إصابة كل الأطفال بتجاويف الأسنان في البلدة. / مستوحى من البيت الأخير من أغنية "القط والعازف"، الأخوان يقرران اصطحاب بعض الأبقار إلى القمر من أجل معرفة ما إذا كانت الجاذبية المنخفضة تنتج أفضل طعم للمثلجات. في المنزل، "سندس" تقرر بأن تستغل غياب الأخوين وتحاول إعداد عشاء فاخر لـ"سامي"، لكنها تفشل بسبب عدم امتلاكها لمهارات الطبخ. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يحاول استخدام جهاز شفط الرطوبة ليحول نباتات جاره إلى اللون البني، لكي تظهر نباتاته باللون الأخضر مقارنةً بنباتات جاره. The Belly of the Beast/Moon Farm
For Harbor Days Festival, Phineas and Ferb celebrate by creating a mechanical version of the historical elusive shark of Danville Harbor. Seeing what the boys are up to, Candace enlists some help to capture the mysterious shark. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz invents the 'Salt Water Taffy-inator' to give cavities to every kid in the Tri State Area./ Inspired by the lost verse from the rhyme, "The Cat and the Fiddle," the boys decide to take some cows to the moon to see if its low gravitational pull actually does produce the best tasting ice cream ever. Back at home, Candace decides to take advantage of the boys being gone and attempts to make a fancy dinner for Jeremy, but her lack of cooking skills don't add anything to the plate. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz attempts to use his 'Moisture Suck-inator ' to turn his neighbor's plants brown, so that his plants will be greener by comparison.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
يوم ميلاد "فارس"
إنه يوم ميلاد "فارس" ومن أجل هذه المناسبة، يجمع "فادي" أفضل اللقطات المفضلة للعصابة. في هذه الأثناء، العميل السري يجب أن يوقف "أبو الأشرار" من استخدام الجهاز لكي يمنع ظهور سيرة أخيه الشخصية من الظهور على التلفاز. Phineas' Birthday Clip-O-Rama! (Part 1 and 2)
It's Phineas' birthday and for the special occasion, Ferb puts together a clip show of the gang's favorite moments. Meanwhile, Agent P must stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz from using his 'non-inator' to pre-empt his brother's biography from appearing on television.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
فارس و فادي
يبدأ "فارس فريد" وأخوه غير الشقيق " فادي فليتشر" المتسم بالدهاء رحلتهما للتغلب على الملل واستغلال كل يوم في عطلتهما الصيفية، البالغة 104 يوم. ومن ضمن مشاريعهما المليئة بالمرح، إنشاء قطار سريع كبير الحجم وإصدار موسم جديد يسمى "سوينتر" ليصبحا بين ليلة وضحاها مغنيين مشهورين لموسيقى البوب وبناء شاطئ في الفناء الخلفي واكتملت بمسابقة ركوب الأمواج والسفر عبر الزمن إلى "العصر الجوراسي". كان يرافقهما طوال هذه المغامرات، حيوان الأسرة الأليف "بيري خلد الماء" الذي تبدو عليه الحماقة، ولكنه دون علم الجميع، يعيش حياة مزدوجة بصفته عميلهما السري الذي يحارب "أبو الأشرار" ببراعة لإنقاذ العالم. وفي هذه الأثناء، تشعر "سندس" بالذهول تجاه تصرفات أخويها الجريئة مما يجعلها تكرس حياتها لتشي بهما إلى والدها ووالدتها، على الرغم من أنها بطريقة ما لا تنجح في القبض عليهم متلبسين. Ask a Foolish Question/ Misperceived Monotreme
When Candace discovers that Phineas and Ferb have invented a computer that can answer anything, she asks it how she can finally bust her brothers once and for all. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz loses the key to his latest invention, the "Take Over the Tri-State Area-inator," and Agent P must find it before he does./ Perry misses his 100th battle against Dr. Doofenshmirtz when Candace takes him to the Charity Pet Wash with her. Perry's absence goes unnoticed when a typical platypus at the Danville Zoo stops Dr. Doofenshmirtz's plan to zap his brother with his "Least Likely-inator." Meanwhile, the boys build a fun house Phineas and Ferb style.

programme.desc:
صوت "هيلين" / متجر البقالة الأسبوعي
تقدم "تايبل تاون" أول مسرحية موسيقية لها، ومن المؤسف أنها تدور حول "هيلين". يواجه كل واحد من آل "تشاترلي" عقبة خلال رحلة تسوق البقالة الأسبوعية. The Sound of Helen/ Weekly Grocery Shop
Table Town School is putting on their first musical, too bad it's all about Helen; The Chatterleys each encounter an obstacle during their weekly grocery shopping trip.

programme.title: مدينة الجرينز الكبيرة - Big City Greens
programme.desc:
مشكلة الديك الرومي / صفقة صعبة
ينضم "بيل" إلى "كريكيت" مرغماً للتستر على جريمة "ديك حبش" في عيد الشكر، ويخوض آل "غرين" مغامرة مجنونة في متجر "سمالتون" للتحف. Turkey Trouble/ Hard Bargain
Bill begrudgingly joins Cricket to cover up a (turkey) crime on Thanksgiving. The Greens get into a crazy hijinks in a Smalton antique shop.

programme.title: مدينة الجرينز الكبيرة - Big City Greens
programme.desc:
طعام الكلاب/التحكم في كريكت
تضبط "غلوريا" "كريكيت" وهو يأكل طعام الكلاب ويتعين عليه منعها من كشف سرّه المخزي. ويثبّت "بيل" أداة أبوية لتراقب "كريكيت" وتؤدبه بالنيابة عنه. Dog Proof/ Cricket Control
Cricket is caught eating dog food by Gloria and must stop her from revealing his secret shame. Bill installs a parenting device to monitor and discipline Cricket for him.

programme.title: مدينة الجرينز الكبيرة - Big City Greens
programme.desc:
التقليد الشتوي / تفوّق "جايد"
تحتاج الجدة إلى مساعدة في تقليد شتوي لكنها تقلق من أن عائلتها لن تساعدها. وبعد شعورها بأن "جايد" تتفوق عليها، تنشئ "غلوريا" صندوقاً للاقتراحات في المقهى لتقلل من سطوة "جايد". Hullabaloo'd/ Jaded
Gramma needs help with a winter tradition but worries her family won’t come through. Feeling overshadowed by Jade, Gloria starts a suggestion box at the cafe to dial Jade back.

programme.title: مدينة الجرينز الكبيرة - Big City Greens: Season 3 Splits
programme.desc:
مدينة الجرينز الكبيرة
تابعوا المغامرات غريبة الأطوار للفتى "كريكيت غرين" البالغ من العمر عشر سنوات وهو صبي ريفي شقي ومتفائل ينتقل إلى المدينة الكبيرة مع عائلته الغريبة والمكونة من الأخت الكبرى "تيلي" والأب "بيل" والجدة "أليس". فضول وحماس "كريكيت" الطبيعيان يقودانه هو وعائلته في رحلات ملحمية وإلى قلوب جيرانه الجدد. Pen Pals
Tilly and Andromeda exchange letters that reveal their unique outlooks on the world.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
اجري يا "سندس" / آخر قطار إلى "باستفيل"
اختراع "فارس" و"فادي" الجديد هو زوج من الأحذية والذي يجعل الشخص الذي يرتديه سريعًا للغاية. "سندس" تقرر ارتداء الحذاء لكي تكون في مكانين في نفس الوقت، ألا وهما في نزهة "سامي" العائلية، حيث قابلت أم "سامي" وفي المكتبة حيث وعدت أمها بأن تقرأ للأطفال. في هذه الأثناء، أبو الأشرار يعرض مبناه للبيع لذلك يحاول إقناع الشارية المحتملة "أنابيل" والتي اتضح أنها قريبة للعائلة، أن المبنى لا يستحق أن الشراء/ حين زيارة الجد والجدة، الولدان يقرران صناعة وسباق منطاد ضخم. في هذه الأثناء، "سندس" تصبح ملهمة من مهندسة قطارات بأن تكف عن إعطاء أخويها وقتًا عصيبًا. في الناحية الأخرى من البلدة، أبو الأشرار يجد بيضة لطائر "دودو" ويصبح مقتنعًا أن الطائر الشرس بإمكانه مساعدته أن يستولي على البلدة، لكنه يكتشف العكس حينما تفقس البيضة... Run, Candace, Run/ Last Train to Bustville
Phineas and Ferb's newest invention is a pair of boots that make the wearer extraordinarily fast. Candace decides to wear them so that she can be in two places at once; at Jeremy's family picnic where she runs into Mrs. Johnson and also at the library where she promised Mom she would read to the kids. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's building is put up for sale so he tries to convince a prospective buyer, Annabelle, who turns out to be a long lost relative of the family, that it is not worth buying./ While visiting their grandparents, the kids decide to create and race a giant hot air balloon. Meanwhile, Candace is inspired by train engineer, Glenda's, can-do attitude and decides to "give up" on busting her brothers. On the other side of town, Dr. Doofenshmirtz finds a Dodo bird egg and is convinced that it is a fierce bird-monster that can help him take over the Tri-state area, but discovers the exact opposite when the egg hatches.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
يوم رائع داخل المنزل / "كانديرمي"
الجو السيئ يفسد خطة "جميلة" في الحصول على رقعة "فتاة فايرسايد"، لذلك "فارس" و"فادي" يبنيان قبة حيوية لمساعدتها. في هذه الأثناء، "سندس" تصبح مجنونة حينما تقرر أنها بحاجة إلى معرفة ما يعجب "سامي" بها. هناك في شركة الشر، "أبو الأشرار" يحاول أن ينزل مطرًا على مباراة كرة قدم لكي يتفرج على مسلسل مكسيكي. / "سندنس" تدرك أنها بحاجة إلى قضاء وقت أكثر مع "زهرة"، لذلك تقرر قضاء يوم كامل معها. لكن حين مقابلة "سامي" وأمه، جهاز أبو الأشرار يصعق "سامي" وأمه ويجعلهما ملتصقين. في هذه الأثناء، "فارس" و"فادي" يخترعان كلبًا روبوتيًا ضخمًا والذي يسبب الأذى الكبير. The Great Indoors /Canderemy
Bad weather spoils Isabella's plan to earn a Fireside Girl patch, so Phineas and Ferb build a huge biodome to help her. Meanwhile, Candace works herself into a frenzy when she decides that she needs to find out what Jeremy likes about her. Over at Evil Inc., Dr. Doofenshmirtz is trying to rain out a big soccer game, just so he can watch his favorite Mexican soap opera./ Candace realizes that she needs to spend more time with Stacey so she vows to spend the whole day with her only. But while visiting Jeremy and his mom, Mrs. Johnson, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's "combine-inator" zaps her and Jeremy, literally joining them at the hip. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb build a giant robot dog that causes a lot of mischief.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
بطن الوحش / مزرعة القمر
من أجل احتفال أيام "الميناء"، يحتفل" فارس" و"فادي" باختراع نسخة ميكانيكية لقرش "ميناء دانفيل" المراوغ. وحينما ترى "سندس" ما يفعله الأخوان، تحاول الحصول على المساعدة للإمساك بالقرش الغامض. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يخترع جهاز للمياة المالحة من أجل إصابة كل الأطفال بتجاويف الأسنان في البلدة. / مستوحى من البيت الأخير من أغنية "القط والعازف"، الأخوان يقرران اصطحاب بعض الأبقار إلى القمر من أجل معرفة ما إذا كانت الجاذبية المنخفضة تنتج أفضل طعم للمثلجات. في المنزل، "سندس" تقرر بأن تستغل غياب الأخوين وتحاول إعداد عشاء فاخر لـ"سامي"، لكنها تفشل بسبب عدم امتلاكها لمهارات الطبخ. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يحاول استخدام جهاز شفط الرطوبة ليحول نباتات جاره إلى اللون البني، لكي تظهر نباتاته باللون الأخضر مقارنةً بنباتات جاره. The Belly of the Beast/Moon Farm
For Harbor Days Festival, Phineas and Ferb celebrate by creating a mechanical version of the historical elusive shark of Danville Harbor. Seeing what the boys are up to, Candace enlists some help to capture the mysterious shark. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz invents the 'Salt Water Taffy-inator' to give cavities to every kid in the Tri State Area./ Inspired by the lost verse from the rhyme, "The Cat and the Fiddle," the boys decide to take some cows to the moon to see if its low gravitational pull actually does produce the best tasting ice cream ever. Back at home, Candace decides to take advantage of the boys being gone and attempts to make a fancy dinner for Jeremy, but her lack of cooking skills don't add anything to the plate. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz attempts to use his 'Moisture Suck-inator ' to turn his neighbor's plants brown, so that his plants will be greener by comparison.

programme.title: عالم الميراكولاس: "شنغهاي"، أسطورة "ليدي دراجون" - Miraculous World: Shanghai, The Legend of Ladydragon
programme.desc:
عالم الميراكولاس: "شنغهاي"، أسطورة "ليدي دراجون"
"مارينيت" في إجازة مدرسية وكل الأمور تسير على ما يرام. حتى يصلها خبر أن "أدريان" ذاهب إلى "شنغهاي"، "الصين"، مع والده. لحسن الحظ، يعيش عمها "وانج" هناك، وقد اقترب عيد ميلاده! لذا، لمقابلة "آدريان" والتعرف على أصول أسرتها، قررت "مارينيت" أن تأخذ هدية العم "وانج" إليه بنفسها. ولكن بعد وقت قصير من وصولها، فقدت "مارينيت" كل أغراضها، بما في ذلك حقيبتها، و"تيكي" والميراكولاس اللذان يتيحان لها التحول إلى الدعسوقة Miraculous World: Shanghai, The Legend of Ladydragon
Marinette is on a school break and everything is fine…until she learns that Adrien had to go to Shanghai, China, with his father. Luckily, her Uncle Wang lives there, and his birthday is coming up soon! To go meet Adrien and her own origins, Marinette decides to take his gift to Uncle Wang herself. But soon after arriving, Marinette loses all her stuff, including her purse, Tikki…and the Miraculous that allows her to turn into Ladybug!

programme.title: Chibi Shorts - Miraculous Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
programme.desc:
The Cake Race
Marinette pours her heart into crafting a stunning birthday cake for her secret love, Adrien. However, she didn’t anticipate Chloe's audacity in showing up with the same cake.

programme.title: ڤامبيرينا: بين عالمين - Vampirina: Teenage Vampire
programme.desc:
أول نهائيّ
حين تطلب في مساعدة ديمي في عرض تقديمي، يصبح سره الغامض عرضة للخطر. في هذه الأثناء، يُدعى إيليا إلى حفلة راب سرية. First Final
When Vee asks for Demi’s help on a class presentation, his ghostly secret is put in danger. Meanwhile, Elijah is invited to an underground rap cypher.

programme.title: ڤامبيرينا: بين عالمين - Vampirina: Teenage Vampire
programme.desc:
أول عطلة
حين تعجز في عن اختيار هدية بابا نويل السرية، تستعين بسكان ترانسلفانيا. كما يعاني إيليا وديمي لإيجاد الهدية المثالية لصوفي. First Holiday
When Vee’s at a loss for what to get her Secret Santa recipient, she enlists some Transylvanian help. Meanwhile, Elijah and Demi struggle to find the perfect gift for Sophie.

programme.title: عالم ميراكولوس، طوكيو: استيلر فورس - Miraculous World: Tokyo, Stellar Force
programme.desc:
عالم ميراكولوس، طوكيو: استيلر فورس
عندما تسافر الدعسوقة إلى طوكيو، تلتقي من جديد بميكي وكازونو، وهما صديقان قديمان لـ كاجامي وعضوان في فريق ستيلارز فريق الأبطال الخارقين الياباني.معًا، يتّحدون لمنع شرير خارق جديد من نشر الفوضى في المدينة. وخلال هذه الرحلة، تكتشف مارينيت، وهي مع كاجامي، أن هناك جوانب عديدة من ماضي صديقتها ما تزال مجهولة لها. Miraculous World: Tokyo, Stellar Force
When Ladybug travels to Tokyo, she reunites with Miki and Kazuno, who are old friends of Kagami and part of the Stellars, a team of Japanese superheroes. Together, they join forces to prevent a new supervillain from wreaking havoc on the city. Throughout this journey, alongside Kagami, Marinette discovers that there is much about her friend’s past that she has yet to uncover.

programme.title: عالم الميراكولاس في باريس: حكايات شيدي باج وكلو نوار - Miraculous World Paris: Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir
programme.desc:
عالم الميراكولاس في باريس: حكايات شيدي باج وكلو نوار
يظهر في باريس حاملو ميراكولاس من عالم موازي. يبدو أن الدعسوقة والقط الأسود يطاردان باترفلاي، تمامًا كما تفعل الدعسوقة والقط الأسود عادة... باستثناء أن كل شيء معكوس بالنسبة لهما. ولأسباب خاطئة، يريد كل من شيدي باج وكلو نوار السيطرة على ميراكولاس الهيسبيريا. فهل تستطيع الدعسوقة والقط الأسود مساعدة هيسبيريا في جعل شيدي باج وكلو نوار الأسود شخصين يتصرفان بشكل أفضل؟ Miraculous World Paris: Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir
Miraculous carriers from a parallel world appear in Paris. Ladybug and Cat Noir seem to be chasing Butterfly, just as Ladybug and Cat Noir usually do... except that for them, everything is reversed. And it's for the wrong reasons that Shadybug and Claw Noir want to take over Hesperia's Miraculous. Can Ladybug and Cat Noir help Hesperia make Shadybug and Claw Noir better people?

programme.desc:
ميراكيلوس: الدعسوقة والقط الأسود
في عالمٍ حيث تتداخل الأسرار مع المشاعر، يقترب "مارينت" و"أدريان" من بعضهما أكثر من أي وقتٍ مضى. ومع ذلك، لا يزال كلٌ منهما يخفي عن الآخر هويته البطولية. لكن "مارينت" تحمل سرًا أشد وطأة؛ فهي تعلم أن والد "أدريان" لم يكن سوى شرير خارق سابق! وفي الوقت نفسه، تجد الدعسوقة والقط الأسود نفسيهما في مواجهة عدو غامض ومراوغ، يسعى بكل دهاء لسرقة "الميراكيلوس" وإغراق باريس في دوامة من الفوضى. وبينما تنطلق المغامرات، يقف أبطالنا جنبًا إلى جنب مع زملائهم في المدرسة وفريق من الأبطال الخارقين الجدد، ليواجهوا عامًا دراسيًا عاصفًا، مليئًا بالمفاجآت والمشاعر الجارفة وكشف الأسرار التي ستغير كل شيء. Mister Agreste
Marinette finds it increasingly difficult to keep a secret from Adrien…and the arrival of a supervillain who looks just like her old enemy won’t help!

Yaksi Gozen
While Adrien wonders how to be as full of surprise as Marinette, Kagami and Felix wonder how to avoid unpleasant surprises.

Revelator
Marinette and Adrien are now the most famous couple in Paris. As such, they catch the attention of an unscrupulous influencer who will do anything to generate buzz….

Climatiqueen
Adrien is worried he doesn't have a passion. Marinette decides to do everything she can to help him find one. Too busy devoting tremendous energy to her task, she doesn't see that someone is watching them, someone who wants to use Adrien's popularity to indulge their own passion... And the arrival of a supervillain determined to steal Ladybug and Cat Noir’s thunder is about to make things worse!

programme.title: Miraculous Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
programme.desc:
Mr Pigeon 72
Mr. Ramier gets akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 72nd time, and now, he can turn people into evil pigeons!

programme.title: Miraculous Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
programme.desc:
Furious Fu
Ladybug and Cat Noir face someone they know well...and never imagined they would have to fight someday.

programme.title: Miraculous Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
programme.desc:
Sole Crusher
A newcomer to Marinette's circle of friends gets akumatized into Sole Crusher, a giant supervillain who can absorb people. Will Ladybug and Cat Noir be up to the task?

programme.title: Miraculous Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
programme.desc:
Queen Banana
When Chloe gets akumatized into Queen Banana, Ladybug decides to entrust a Miraculous to a new and promising ally to help her stop the supervillain.

programme.title: عالم ميراكولوس لندن: على حافة الزمن - Miraculous World London: At the Edge of Time
programme.desc:
عالم ميراكولوس لندن: على حافة الزمن
لإنقاذ المستقبل من مصير مشؤوم، تتحول "مارينات" إلى حشرة عابرة للزمن تُسمى "كرونو بغ" وتتحد مع "بانيكس" لهزيمة خصم غامض يسافر عبر الزمن. من يكون هذا الشرير الخارق، وما سبب إصراره على كشف الهوية السرية للبطلة الخارقة "مارينات"؟ الأمل الوحيد أمام "مارينات" هو هزيمة خصمها الجديد للحيلولة دون نهاية "الدعسوقة" ونهاية الزمن نفسه! Miraculous World London: At the Edge of Time
To save the future from a terrible fate, Marinette becomes Chronobug and teams up with Bunnyx to defeat a mysterious opponent who travels through time. Who is this new supervillain, and why are they obsessed with exposing Marinette’s secret superhero identity? Marinette’s only hope is to defeat her new opponent to prevent the end of Ladybug and time itself!

programme.title: عالم الميراكولاس: "شنغهاي"، أسطورة "ليدي دراجون" - Miraculous World: Shanghai, The Legend of Ladydragon
programme.desc:
عالم الميراكولاس: "شنغهاي"، أسطورة "ليدي دراجون"
"مارينيت" في إجازة مدرسية وكل الأمور تسير على ما يرام. حتى يصلها خبر أن "أدريان" ذاهب إلى "شنغهاي"، "الصين"، مع والده. لحسن الحظ، يعيش عمها "وانج" هناك، وقد اقترب عيد ميلاده! لذا، لمقابلة "آدريان" والتعرف على أصول أسرتها، قررت "مارينيت" أن تأخذ هدية العم "وانج" إليه بنفسها. ولكن بعد وقت قصير من وصولها، فقدت "مارينيت" كل أغراضها، بما في ذلك حقيبتها، و"تيكي" والميراكولاس اللذان يتيحان لها التحول إلى الدعسوقة Miraculous World: Shanghai, The Legend of Ladydragon
Marinette is on a school break and everything is fine…until she learns that Adrien had to go to Shanghai, China, with his father. Luckily, her Uncle Wang lives there, and his birthday is coming up soon! To go meet Adrien and her own origins, Marinette decides to take his gift to Uncle Wang herself. But soon after arriving, Marinette loses all her stuff, including her purse, Tikki…and the Miraculous that allows her to turn into Ladybug!

programme.title: ميراكيلوس: الدعسوقة والقط الأسود - Miraculous Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir: Season 6
programme.desc:
ميراكيلوس: الدعسوقة والقط الأسود
في عالمٍ حيث تتداخل الأسرار مع المشاعر، يقترب "مارينت" و"أدريان" من بعضهما أكثر من أي وقتٍ مضى. ومع ذلك، لا يزال كلٌ منهما يخفي عن الآخر هويته البطولية. لكن "مارينت" تحمل سرًا أشد وطأة؛ فهي تعلم أن والد "أدريان" لم يكن سوى شرير خارق سابق! وفي الوقت نفسه، تجد الدعسوقة والقط الأسود نفسيهما في مواجهة عدو غامض ومراوغ، يسعى بكل دهاء لسرقة "الميراكيلوس" وإغراق باريس في دوامة من الفوضى. وبينما تنطلق المغامرات، يقف أبطالنا جنبًا إلى جنب مع زملائهم في المدرسة وفريق من الأبطال الخارقين الجدد، ليواجهوا عامًا دراسيًا عاصفًا، مليئًا بالمفاجآت والمشاعر الجارفة وكشف الأسرار التي ستغير كل شيء. Climatiqueen
Adrien is worried he doesn't have a passion. Marinette decides to do everything she can to help him find one. Too busy devoting tremendous energy to her task, she doesn't see that someone is watching them, someone who wants to use Adrien's popularity to indulge their own passion... And the arrival of a supervillain determined to steal Ladybug and Cat Noir’s thunder is about to make things worse!

programme.title: عالم ميراكولوس، طوكيو: استيلر فورس - Miraculous World: Tokyo, Stellar Force
programme.desc:

عندما تسافر الدعسوقة إلى طوكيو، تلتقي من جديد بميكي وكازونو، وهما صديقان قديمان لـ كاجامي وعضوان في فريق ستيلارز فريق الأبطال الخارقين الياباني.معًا، يتّحدون لمنع شرير خارق جديد من نشر الفوضى في المدينة. وخلال هذه الرحلة، تكتشف مارينيت، وهي مع كاجامي، أن هناك جوانب عديدة من ماضي صديقتها ما تزال مجهولة لها. Miraculous World: Tokyo, Stellar Force
When Ladybug travels to Tokyo, she reunites with Miki and Kazuno, who are old friends of Kagami and part of the Stellars, a team of Japanese superheroes. Together, they join forces to prevent a new supervillain from wreaking havoc on the city. Throughout this journey, alongside Kagami, Marinette discovers that there is much about her friend’s past that she has yet to uncover.

programme.title: عالم الميراكولاس في باريس: حكايات شيدي باج وكلو نوار - Miraculous World Paris: Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir
programme.desc:
عالم الميراكولاس في باريس: حكايات شيدي باج وكلو نوار
يظهر في باريس حاملو ميراكولاس من عالم موازي. يبدو أن الدعسوقة والقط الأسود يطاردان باترفلاي، تمامًا كما تفعل الدعسوقة والقط الأسود عادة... باستثناء أن كل شيء معكوس بالنسبة لهما. ولأسباب خاطئة، يريد كل من شيدي باج وكلو نوار السيطرة على ميراكولاس الهيسبيريا. فهل تستطيع الدعسوقة والقط الأسود مساعدة هيسبيريا في جعل شيدي باج وكلو نوار الأسود شخصين يتصرفان بشكل أفضل؟ Miraculous World Paris: Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir
Miraculous carriers from a parallel world appear in Paris. Ladybug and Cat Noir seem to be chasing Butterfly, just as Ladybug and Cat Noir usually do... except that for them, everything is reversed. And it's for the wrong reasons that Shadybug and Claw Noir want to take over Hesperia's Miraculous. Can Ladybug and Cat Noir help Hesperia make Shadybug and Claw Noir better people?

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
Phineas And Ferb S2 Ep60
حين يقضي فريد-فليتشر إجازة في هاواي، تقرر "سندس" أنها ستحاول الاسترخاء. يحاول"فارس"و"فادي إعادة الحياة إلى الثدييات المائية ويحاول الدكتور "أبو الأشرار" إلغاء تطور البشرية. في هذه الأثناء، يتعلم والدتهما ووالدهما ركوب الأمواج. / يواصل "فارس" و"فادي" البحث عن أنشطة في هاواي للترفيه عنهما، في حين أن "سندس" مقتنعة بأنها وجدت عقدًا جالب لحسن الحظ، إلى أن يزداد حظها سوءًا. وفي هذه الأثناء، أثبت "أبو الأشرار" أن إلغاء التطور لا يسير كما كان يأمل، مما أدى إلى إلغاء تطوره وتركه محاصرًا في جزيرة صحراوية. Phineas and Ferb Hawaiian Vacation (Part I and 2)
When the Flynn-Fletcher on vacation in Hawaii, Candace decides she is going to try and relax. Phineas and Ferb try to bring Aqua Primates to life and Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to de-evolve mankind. Meanwhile, Mom and Dad learn to surf./ Phineas and Ferb continue to look for activities on Hawaii to amuse them, while Candace is convinced she has found a good luck charm necklace, until her luck keeps getting worse. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's De-Evolutionator proves to not work as well as he hoped, de-evolving him and leaving him trapped on a desert island.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
هيا لنلعب/ ضبط "سندس"
تتبادل "سندس" الأدوار مع أميرة تشبهها تمامًا، لكن التصرفات الغريبة المستمرة من "فارس" و"فادي" تمنعها من الاستمتاع بالرفاهية الملكية حتى ليوم واحد. وفي هذه الأثناء، يستعين "فارس" و"فادي" بالأميرة لمساعدتهما في بناء صندوق موسيقي عملاق مليء بالفرق الموسيقية للعرض المباشر ويخطط الدكتور "أبو الأشرار" لاستخدام آلته لتدمير تفاني شقيقه في دار الأوبرا بالمدينة./ عندما تقوم "ليندا" و"لورانس" برحلة، يكلفا "سندس" أن تتحمل مسؤولية المنزل، ولكن بعد ذلك ظهرت "زهرة" وابنة عمها "سارة" و"جيرمي"، وقبل فترة طويلة كانت "سندس" تقيم دون قصد حفلة كبيرة. وتعود "ليندا" إلى المنزل لتأكيد شكوكها، وتنتقل الحفلة بأكملها في ظروف غامضة إلى مكان آخر وقد يتورط "أبو الأشرار" وآلة سرعته في الأمر. يقوم ضيوف شرف "صوفيا بوش" بدور "سارة". Make Play /Candace Gets Busted
Candace switches places with a princess who looks just like her but the ongoing antics of Phineas and Ferb prevent her from enjoying the royal luxuries, even for a day. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb enlist the princess to help them build a giant jukebox filled with live bands, and Dr. Doofenshmirtz plans on using his Claw-inator to ruin his brother's dedication of the Danville Opera House./ When Linda and Lawrence take a trip, they entrust Candace to be in charge of the house but then Stacy, her cousin Sara and Jeremy show up, and before long Candace is inadvertently hosting a giant party. Just as Linda returns home to confirm her suspicions, the entire party mysteriously moves to another location and Dr. Doofenshmirtz's go away-inator may be involved. Sophia Bush guest stars as Sara.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
الصيف ملكك!
إنه الانقلاب الصيفي، ونظرًا لأنه أطول يوم في السنة، قرر الأخوان "فارس" و"فادي" السفر حول العالم في يوم واحد. لكن لم يصدق أحد أن بإمكانهم فعلًا تحقيق ما شرعوا في القيام به، مما دفعهم للحصول على بعض الكلمات التشجيعية في شكل ثنائي، من "كلاي أيكن" و"تشاكا خان". وفي هذه الأثناء، يقوم الدكتور "أبو الأشرار" برحلة بين أب وابنته، إلى "طوكيو" مع "فايزة" Phineas and Ferb Summer Belongs to You! (Part 1 and 2)
It's the summer solstice and because it's the longest day of the year, stepbrothers Phineas and Ferb decide to travel around the world in one day. But not everyone believes they can actually achieve what they've set out to do, leading them to get some encouraging words, in the form of a duet, from Clay Aiken and Chaka Khan. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz takes a father-daughter trip to Tokyo with Vanessa.
